sentences.en: The more we learn, the better we realize our ignorance.
sentences.zh: 我们学得越多，就越意识到自己的无知。

sentences.en: The more you study, the more you discover your ignorance.
sentences.zh: 你学得越多，就越发现自己有很多不知道的东西。

sentences.en: The problem has arisen from your ignorance of the matter.
sentences.zh: 这个问题源于他对此事的无知。
